About the Scholarship

Edinburgh’s Machine Learning Systems CDT studies machine learning methods and the computing systems that implement them. International candidates apply through the first recruitment round.

Research Areas

  • Machine learning methods
  • computing systems and engineering

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
FundingFull Home/Overseas tuition plus stipend and research/travel funding, subject to award terms.
MaintenanceStipend available; confirm the current rate
Duration4 years

Eligibility and Requirements

Relevant 2:1-equivalent degree and preparation for machine learning/systems research; International applicants use Round 1. English evidence, approved equivalents and waivers depend on the programme; IELTS is not a universal requirement for every applicant.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
RecruitmentOpen; deadline confirmation needed
DeadlineDeadline discrepancy: main CDT page and Stage 1 table say 14 December 2026, 23:59; narrative says 10 December; course page says 11 December. Confirm with CDT.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 14 December 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Use the official first-stage application route. Shortlisted candidates are invited to EUCLID; the Stage 2 table gives 21 January 2027, 23:59.

The official pages disagree on Round 1 dates. No single deadline has been stored as authoritative; prepare for the earliest date and contact the CDT.

About the University of Edinburgh

The University of Edinburgh offers doctoral research across science, engineering, humanities, social sciences and health. Its research schools host scholarship competitions and doctoral training programmes with different admission and funding routes.
